name: High-Tea Platter (For Two)
description: Lavish 3-tier spread featuring savory rolls, wings, panini, mini pizza, mac & cheese, pastries, donuts, and fresh drinks.
recipe: Assembled fresh on a 3-tier platter with hot savories fried to order, artisan pastries from the bakery counter, and chilled mocktails.

name: High-Tea Platter (For Three)
description: Grand tiered high-tea spread with generous portions of 10+ gourmet savories, sweets, and fresh lime mojitos.
recipe: Crafted fresh for groups of three with hot appetizers straight from the kitchen and decadent cafe dessert miniatures.

name: Grand Ramadan Iftar Buffet
description: Extensive 35+ dish buffet with dates, dahi bhallay, pakoras, chicken handi, beef nihari, biryani, naan, and sweets.
priceNote: TODO verify exact per-head buffet price from seasonal Ramadan board
recipe: Over 35 traditional and continental delicacies prepared in massive batches every afternoon for the sunset adhan.

name: Shahi Gulab Jamun
description: Soft, golden-fried pure khoya dumplings soaked in fragrant cardamom and rose sugar syrup.
recipe: Fresh whole-milk khoya is kneaded smoothly, hand-rolled into uniform spheres, deep-fried on gentle heat in pure ghee, and soaked in warm rose syrup.

name: Bengali Rasgulla
description: Spongy, delicate chhena spheres slow-simmered in light aromatic cardamom syrup.
recipe: Fresh cottage cheese is thoroughly kneaded until oils release, rolled into smooth balls, and simmered in boiling light syrup until doubled and spongy.

name: Royal Kaju Barfi
description: Diamond-cut cashew fudge made with premium cashews, finished with edible silver warq.
recipe: Stone-ground cashew paste is cooked on low flame with one-string sugar syrup, kneaded hot into a silky dough, rolled thin, and topped with silver leaf.

name: Crispy Desi Ghee Jalebi
description: Golden spirals of crisp fermented batter fried in desi ghee and steeped in saffron sugar syrup.
recipe: Fermented batter is piped directly through a muslin cloth into bubbling hot ghee, fried until crunchy, and immediately dipped in warm saffron nectar.

name: Motichoor Laddu
description: Tiny saffron-kissed gram flour pearls fried in ghee, bound together with cardamom and melon seeds.
recipe: Fine batter is passed through a perforated ladle into hot ghee, soaked in warm saffron syrup, and hand-rolled warm into spheres.

name: Multani Sohan Halwa
description: Rich caramelised wheat-sprout halwa loaded with crunchy almonds, walnuts, and green cardamom.
recipe: Sprouted wheat flour and milk are continuously stirred in copper cauldrons for six hours over firewood until dense, glossy, and caramelised.

name: Special Desi Ghee Pateesa
description: Flaky, melting layers of roasted gram flour and caramelised sugar, garnished with pistachios.
recipe: Hot pulled sugar syrup is layered and stretched repeatedly with roasted besan in ghee to produce hundreds of paper-thin flaky sheets.

name: Chocolate Truffle Cake
description: Three layers of rich chocolate sponge filled and frosted with dark Belgian chocolate ganache.
recipe: Moist buttermilk-cocoa sponge is baked fresh daily, brushed with espresso simple syrup, filled with ganache, and crowned with dark chocolate shards.

name: Classic Red Velvet Cake
description: Velvety crimson sponge layered with creamy Philadelphia-style cream cheese frosting.
recipe: Tender cocoa-buttermilk red sponge is stacked with smooth, whipped cream cheese frosting and dusted with red velvet sponge crumbles.

name: Fresh Pineapple Cream Cake
description: Light vanilla sponge soaked in pineapple nectar, layered with real fruit chunks and whipped cream.
recipe: Airy sponge cake layers are soaked with pineapple compote syrup, frosted with fresh dairy cream, and decorated with glazed pineapple slices.

name: Custom Tiered Celebration Cake
description: Bespoke 2 to 4-tier event cakes tailored to your wedding, engagement, or birthday theme.
recipe: Handcrafted to order by our master bakers, with customised tiers, delicate floral piping, and personalized flavour combinations.

name: Golden Chicken Patties
description: Flaky puff pastry parcels bursting with seasoned shredded chicken and black pepper white sauce.
recipe: Laminated puff pastry dough is stuffed with creamy pepper chicken filling, scored, egg-washed, and baked until puffed high and golden.

name: Baker's Cream Roll
description: Crisp, caramelised puff pastry horn filled generously with sweet vanilla whipped cream.
recipe: Strips of puff dough are wound around conical steel moulds, rolled in sugar, baked until caramelized, and piped full of sweet chilled cream.

name: Crispy Aloo Samosa
description: Crunchy crust filled with cumin-tempered spiced potatoes, peas, and green chilies.
recipe: Stiff dough with carom seeds is rolled, shaped into cones, stuffed with aromatic potato filling, and slow-fried to crispy perfection.

name: Chicken Tikka Pizza Bread
description: Soft baked bread boat topped with tikka chicken, capsicum, marinara, and gooey mozzarella.
recipe: Handmade bread dough boats are brushed with herb sauce, loaded with mozzarella and marinated chicken chunks, then baked golden.

name: Morning Cake Rusk
description: Twice-baked crunchy sweet sponge biscuits, the quintessence of Pakistani tea time.
recipe: Rich sponge cake is baked, cooled, sliced into fingers, and baked a second time at low temperature until evenly crisp and dry.

name: Clay-Oven Tandoori Naan
description: Pillowy, smoky flatbread baked on the fiery clay walls of our traditional tandoor.
recipe: Dough fermented with yogurt is hand-slapped onto tandoor gaddi, baked directly against clay coals for 90 seconds, and brushed with butter.

name: Sesame Roghni Naan
description: Soft, enriched bread with embossed patterns, brushed with ghee and sprinkled with toasted sesame.
recipe: Milk-enriched dough is finger-dimpled with decorative grooves, brushed with ghee and egg, seeded, and flash-baked in the tandoor.

name: Special Stuffed Aloo Kulcha
description: Flaky, layered bread stuffed with zesty spiced mashed potatoes and fresh coriander.
recipe: Stuffed with seasoned potato and anardana, rolled carefully, and baked until the surface blisters into crisp buttery layers.

name: Hot Buffalo Wings (6 pcs)
description: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature buttery cayenne hot pepper sauce.
priceNote: TODO verify exact appetizer price from Nazarah Cafe counter board
recipe: Wings are dry-brined, fried crisp until golden, and vigorously tossed in simmering tangy cayenne pepper glaze.

name: Crumbed Fried Chicken Fingers
description: Tender chicken tenderloins breaded in seasoned panko crumbs, served with honey mustard dip.
priceNote: TODO verify exact appetizer price from Nazarah Cafe counter board
recipe: Marinated strips are double-dredged in seasoned flour and crispy panko, then fried until golden and juicy.

name: Chicken Corn Soup
description: Comforting silky chicken broth with sweet cream-style corn, shredded chicken, and egg ribbons.
recipe: Slow-simmered bone broth is simmered with sweet corn, thickened with starch, finished with beaten egg ribbons, and served piping hot.

name: Hot & Sour Red Soup
description: Spicy and tangy Chinese broth packed with shredded chicken, black mushrooms, tofu, and vinegar.
recipe: Broth is infused with chili oils and aged dark vinegar, loaded with shredded vegetables and chicken, and balanced with egg ribbons.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo Pasta
description: Ribbon pasta tossed in a velvety garlic cream and parmesan sauce, topped with grilled chicken.
priceNote: TODO verify exact pasta price from Nazarah Cafe menu
recipe: Al dente fettuccine is tossed in a hot reduction of heavy cream, roasted garlic, and parmesan, topped with herb-seared chicken.

name: Oven Baked Mac & Cheese
description: Elbow macaroni enveloped in a cheddar-mozzarella mornay sauce, baked with a golden crust.
recipe: Macaroni is blended with a rich three-cheese mornay sauce, transferred to a skillet, topped with breadcrumbs, and broiled bubbly.

name: Chicken Manchurian with Fried Rice
description: Tender chicken cubes in a sweet, savory, and spicy red ginger-garlic sauce served with egg fried rice.
priceNote: TODO verify exact Chinese combo price
recipe: Battered chicken is flash-fried, tossed in wok with spring onions, garlic, and sweet chilli glaze, served alongside egg fried basmati.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Wok-seared diced chicken with dry red chillies, crunchy roasted peanuts, and green bell peppers.
recipe: Chicken is stir-fried in a fiery wok with toasted peanuts, chili pods, and sweet soy glaze for an authentic spicy crunch.

name: Nazarah Special Chicken Chowmein
description: Hand-pulled noodles stir-fried with julienned vegetables, chicken breast, and dark aromatic soy sauce.
recipe: Fresh noodles are tossed on intense wok heat with crisp garden vegetables, shredded chicken, and toasted sesame oil.

name: Crispy Zinger Burger
description: Thick crispy battered fried chicken thigh with iceberg lettuce and secret sauce in a toasted sesame bun.
recipe: Chicken is marinated in spice buttermilk, flaked with double flour crust, deep-fried crunchy, and assembled with cold slaw.

name: Tikka Delight Pizza (Medium)
description: Hand-stretched dough topped with smoky chicken tikka, red onions, capsicum, and 100% mozzarella cheese.
recipe: Dough is hand-tossed, spread with rich tomato-herb sauce, loaded with charcoal chicken tikka and mozzarella, baked in a 350°C stone oven.

name: Grilled BBQ Panini
description: Toasted ciabatta bread pressed with smoky BBQ chicken, caramelized onions, and melted cheese.
recipe: Panini bread is layered with saucy grilled chicken and cheese, brushed with garlic herb butter, and grill-pressed crisp.

name: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten center of flowing dark chocolate, paired with a scoop of vanilla gelato.
recipe: Individual chocolate cakes are baked at high heat so the outer cake sets while the heart remains warm and molten.

name: Biscoff Lotus Mousse Cup
description: Creamy whipped Lotus Biscoff mousse layered with crushed biscuit crumble and warm spread.
recipe: Lotus speculoos cream is folded into light whipped mousse, layered over crushed cookie crust, and finished with warm Lotus drizzle.

name: Traditional Sweet Lassi
description: Thick, creamy churned yogurt beverage topped with a generous dollop of fresh milk malai.
recipe: Full-fat curd is hand-churned in wooden madhani with chilled milk and sugar, poured tall, and crowned with thick cream.

name: Korean Brown Sugar Boba
description: Chewy tapioca pearls simmered in rich caramelized brown sugar syrup, filled with fresh chilled milk.
recipe: Boba pearls are slow-cooked in thick muscovado sugar syrup, swirled around cup walls for tiger stripes, and topped with chilled milk.

name: Special Doodh Patti Chai
description: Strong, rich Pakistani tea brewed entirely in pure whole milk with crushed cardamom pods.
recipe: Strong loose tea leaves are boiled and frothed vigorously directly in simmering whole buffalo milk until deeply tanned and aromatic.

name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
description: Freshly pulled espresso poured over cold vanilla milk, topped with a buttery caramel drizzle.
recipe: Chilled vanilla-infused milk over ice is 'marked' with a fresh double espresso shot and criss-crossed with caramel.

name: Royal Velvet Mithai Box
description: Luxurious assorted gift box with kaju barfi, gulab jamun, motichoor laddu, and dry fruit sweets.
recipe: Hand-picked fresh sweets of the day, individually encased in gold-foil cups within a heavy gold-embossed branded gift box.

name: Classic Celebration Sweet Box
description: Traditional 1kg assortment of Vehari's favourite everyday sweets for congratulations and family visits.
recipe: A balanced selection of our top-selling sweets, freshly packed and sealed with our signature ribbon.
